claims.claim: Leaders 1354 is an operating Chicago sneaker and streetwear boutique, used as a boutique-first seeding door.
claims.evidence: Time Out and a brand profile place the store at 1152 W. Madison St. in the West Loop, stocking Nike and adidas footwear. It was founded in 2002 by Corey Gilkey at 1354 E. 53rd St. in Hyde Park. An older ChooseChicago interview gives 672 N. Wells St., likely a past address.
claims.action: retail-landscape.json: set the Leaders 1354 neighborhood to West Loop (1152 W. Madison St).

claims.claim: The Rink Fitness Factory on East 87th St is the home floor of JB skating and the launch venue for the Rink Session track suit.
